text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Far away, across the sea—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I want to spread my wings and soar far 
and wide. Just like that great 
Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I visited the URA-designated tailor 
to pick up Cheval Grand's racing silk that 
had been sent in for maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel on you~? Is the hem 
length looking alright? Please let me know 
if there's anything bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes... I'm, okay...
choice_data_list: It seems fine, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that. Still... What a 
wonderful racing outfit! Especially that 
cape!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It really brings out your dignity, Cheval 
Grand-san... It suits you wonderfully~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...! Ah... No, I'm totally— ......

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Um, th... thank you... very much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand has been in high spirits 
since then. She seems absolutely thrilled 
that her racing cape was praised.
choice_data_list: Is there some meaning behind that cloak?
Is there some meaning behind that cloak?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――! Huh, what...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry, I got a little carried 
away...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I didn't decide on the design of my 
racing outfit all by myself... Most of the 
fine details were suggestions from my 
older and younger sisters...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still... not my cape, anything but 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if the main color is white, let's add 
a yellow tie as an accent color♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For bottoms, short shorts are definitely 
the way to go! Cheval-chi would look super 
cute in those!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... What do you want to do, 
Cheval? This is your racing outfit, after 
all, so what you want matters too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Sure, I was hesitating anyway... 
Besides, Vivlos has way better taste than 
someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No. Where else are you hesitating on? 
For instance... the inner layer? I think 
black would tighten things up nicely here.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. Then I'll do that...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, let's make the back 
cute too! Make the cape heart-shaped, and 
the pattern—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —No capes!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry...! B-But, I'd like to 
keep... the cape as it is.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Does it hold some special meaning for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………It's my... vow.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—I'm carrying dreams on my shoulders. My 
own... very special dream...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Like the great Umamusume I looked up to 
that day... Like the Umamusume who never 
gave up no matter what, and won the 
applause of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I want to gallop grandly to wherever the 
road leads. I want to carve out my own 
destiny with these legs."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—I want to become an Umamusume who spreads 
her wings to the world.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I put on that cape... I feel like I can 
do it. Deliver incredible results on the 
world stage and prove my strength.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Someday—to the peak.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Someday—to the peak.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll stand at the very top
I'm sure you'll stand at the very top.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has the talent to accomplish it. She 
has the tenacity to reach it. I know that 
better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
――...It's strange. Trainer's eyes 
always...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. ...I will... do my 
best――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
High and far away. Looking up at the 
endlessly expanding sky, the two of them 
shared their dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning plenty of graded races goes 
without saying, but I want to go after 
overseas GIs too. With her, there's no 
limit to how high we can climb!
choice_data_list: Let's win big all over the world!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! And with that, someday, the best 
in the world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry for shouting...
choice_data_list: No, no, the pleasure is all mine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, we had drawn the stares 
of passersby... Shrugging our shoulders a 
bit, the two of us headed back to the 
academy.
